verses.gurmukhi: ੧੪ : ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਕੂੰ ਪਾਵੇ ? ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹ
verses.translit_en: 14 : keetaa karate noo(n) kikoo(n) paave ? gaaddee raah

en.bdb: How creation could attain the Creator? The highway     ?

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar aakaar kar gur moorat hui dhiaan dharaiaa|

en.bdb: The formless Lord assumed shape and getting established in the form of Guru made all to meditate upon Lord (here the hint is towards Guru Nanak).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan gursikh kar saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa|

en.bdb: He accepted disciples from all the four varnas and founded the abode of treuth in the form of holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: vedh katebahu baaharaa akath kathaa gur sabadh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: He explained the grandeur of that word of the Guru beyond the Vedas and the Katebas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਹ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: veehaa a(n)dhar varatamaan gurmukh hoi ikeeh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Those who indulged in scores of evils were now put to meditate upon the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa vich udhaas kar naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa|

en.bdb: They were kept detached amidst maya and were made to understand the importance of that holy name, charity and ablution.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baareh pa(n)th ikatr kar gurmukh gaaddee raahu chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Gathering the twelve sects together, he prepared a high path of gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਚੜਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: pat pauRee chaR nij ghar aaiaa ||14||

en.bdb: Following that path (or order) and mounting the stairs of honour they have all stabilised in their true selves.
